decisions.reason: real active exploitation event: Dutch NCSC warns CVE-2026-65400, a macOS Screen Sharing auth bypass fixed Aug 6 in Tahoe 26.6.1/Sequoia 15.7.9/Sonoma 14.8.9, is being exploited in the wild against systems with port 5900 exposed; attackers gained root and deployed a Monero miner; public exploit code has emerged

CVE-2026-65400.evidence: The NCSC has received a notification indicating that active abuse of this vulnerability has been observed on multiple systems on which port 5900 was accessible from the Internet. In all these cases, root had been accessed on the affected system, and a Monero crypto miner had been placed.
